jobs.occupation: Senior Product Marketing Manager (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description: Short DescriptionSPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, Stadler, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia / General Catalyst, and Salesforce.In this role, you own how SPREAD is positioned, messaged, and understood by engineering leaders at enterprise accounts. You translate a deeply technical product into narratives that win deals, arm Sales with competitive intelligence and enablement assets, and partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior marketing team alongside Growth, GTM Ops, and Design.Your Mission• Own positioning and messaging for SPREAD's platform, turning engineering intelligence into value propositions that land with top engineering leaders.• Build and maintain competitive intelligence across the PLM and engineering data landscape and turn it into battle cards and objection-handling guides that Sales uses daily.• Create sales enablement assets that shorten enterprise sales cycles and improve win rates.• Partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market for product releases, connecting every launch to a measurable customer outcome.• Develop thought leadership content that builds credibility with deeply technical audiences.• Partner with Growth and GTM Ops on campaign messaging and account targeting so demand gen speaks the right language to the right pain points.• Represent SPREAD at industry events and customer conversations where engineering leaders expect a peer-level discussion about their domain.Your Experience• 5+ years in B2B product marketing or technical product management for enterprise software or complex technical products, with hands-on ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market.• Technical fluency through an engineering or technical degree, or through deep experience managing or marketing highly technical products. You can hold a credible conversation about data architectures, PLM tool landscapes, or software-defined product development.• Experience building sales enablement for complex enterprise deals (€100K+ ACV, 6-12-month cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees).• Strong competitive intelligence instinct. You track competitors, articulate differentiation in the buyer's language, and prepare sales teams for live objection handling.• AI-native working style. You use AI tools daily to scale your output, from content creation to research to workflow automation. SPREAD is an AI-first company, and every team member operates accordingly.• Identity as a product marketer. You partner with Product and Engineering, you speak their language, but your craft is marketing, not roadmaps or feature specs.• Native or near-native English. Working-level German minimum. If German is your native language, strong English is sufficient.• Based in Berlin or close enough for regular in-office collaboration, especially during the first months.Why SPREAD?• Work on Agentic Engineering Intelligence that helps leading manufacturers master software-defined complexity. You market technology that engineering leaders genuinely care about.• High ownership and measurable impact. You connect your positioning directly to deal outcomes and pipeline.• A senior team that values craft, speed, and accountability over process and hierarchy.• Strong overall package including attractive compensation and an annual learning budget.• Mobility and wellbeing support through a Deutschlandticket mobility budget, bike-leasing and an Urban Sports partnership.• Time off and flexibility with 30 vacation days, workation options, and one paid volunteering day per year.ContactDmytro İefymenko recruiting@spread.aiSPREAD AIKöpenicker Str. 40c | 10179 BerlinStay connected—follow us on LinkedIn for the latest insights and updatesAbout usSPREAD is pioneering Agentic Engineering Intelligence . Our low-code platform transforms fragmented hardware and software product data into dynamic Product Twins , creating an AI-ready knowledge base that powers smarter decisions and automation across the entire product lifecycle.At the heart of our technology lies the world’s first Universal Engineering Information Model (EIN) — a semantic framework that connects domain-specific and lifecycle data into a federated Engineering Intelligence Graph , continuously evolving over time. This foundation enables specialized AI agents to execute tasks like compliance checks, dependency analysis, and specification generation — seamlessly integrated into the tools engineers already use.The impact is tangible: companies using SPREAD achieve up to 10x faster time-to-market , 50% lower lifecycle costs , and significantly higher product quality .Industry leaders such as Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Rheinmetall , and others rely on SPREAD to build the next generation of software-defined products.Headquartered in Berlin, SPREAD delivers enterprise-grade security (ISO 27001 & TISAX), full GDPR compliance , and flexible deployment options — in the cloud or on-premises.Our VisionThe future of engineering is data-driven and agentic . We make product data the most accessible, intuitive, and impactful resource in engineering — so that engineers can unleash their full creativity and drive innovation at scale.

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.Your tasks:- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.Essential experience/ qualifications:- Above the average motivation and work ethics- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology- English writing and speaking skills- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalentadditional advantages:- Experience in omics data science- Hands-on experience in human immunologyWe offer:- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors- High end translational research- State-of-the-art laboratories- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )- Comprehensive health promotion offers- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)- Family-friendly enviromentFurther information:Prof. Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerMedizinische Klinik 5Phone: 09131 - 85 43107Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenMedizinische Klinik 5 -Hämatologie & Internistische OnkologiePD Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerUlmenweg 1891054 Erlangen

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)Transform the everyday.This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.What we offer you- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Diverse health and wellness offerings- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of SiemensSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.How you will make an Impact with us- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.What you bringLeadership & Governance- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.Mechanical & Mechatronic Components- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.Methodological Expertise- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:- Process FMEA- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)- 8D Problem Solving- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis- 5 Why Analysis- Pareto Analysis- Process Audits- Corrective Action Management- Lessons Learned Processes- Control Plans- KPI and Performance Reviews- Structured Escalation ProcessesCommunication & Collaboration- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise.otc2026diotc2026di
